verdict.rationale: Trivy's docs confirm secret scanning for container images, filesystem, and git repos (trivy-docs-3, trivy-docs-10, trivy-probe-6), covering Docker images well, but there is no documentation of scanning CI logs, and the only evidence of an S3/AWS-style target ('trivy aws') is a community report of it crashing with a nil-pointer panic (trivy-comm-15), not a working secret-scan of S3 buckets. Missing for 10: documented S3 bucket secret scanning, CI log ingestion/scanning, and a working (non-crashing) cloud-target example.
